message.content:
Got the initial results from the failed_jobs query. There are 1204 failed jobs with 47 malformed rows. The pg_dump export has been initiated and should take about 20 minutes. 

Next steps:
1. Investigate the root cause of the failed jobs.
2. Clear the backlog by retrying the failed jobs.
3. Monitor the system to prevent future failures.

I will now submit the report.
